title: Law to create a city registry and fund for legacy businesses
summary: This bill would direct the Department of Small Business Services to create a Legacy Business Registry recognizing businesses that have operated in New York City for at least 20 years and contributed to a neighborhood's history or character. Businesses would need a nomination from the mayor, public advocate, a borough president or a council member, and the agency would consult the local community board and Landmarks Preservation Commission before designation. The bill also sets up a Legacy Business Preservation Fund to give grants to qualifying businesses facing displacement risk and to landlords who sign them to 10-year leases.
